option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific cardiac conduction abnormality (RBBB) and a cause of cardiac arrest (hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation), neither of which are directly related to the provided leaf 'Massive pulmonary embolism causing pulseless electrical activity cardiac arrest'.

The option describes a general category of cardiac rhythm or conduction issues. The provided leaf is a specific cause of cardiac arrest (Massive pulmonary embolism), not a general arrhythmia or conduction abnormality itself.
